title: Harbor and Postcard Revisited
author: Vesper Marchetti
blurb: Elodie Amberdale, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
